verdict.rationale: Oneleet hosts Scalar-rendered interactive API references for both its Public API (157 paths) and its Auditor API, built from live OpenAPI 3.0.3 documents and linked from the docs as "interactive references". The runnable-examples part is only implied: the request client is Scalar's unconfigured library default, and executing calls needs a real service key against the caller's own workspace data, with no sandbox. missing for 10: explicitly documented try-it/runnable request examples, a sandbox or test environment for safe execution, independent hands-on corroboration of the interactive console.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
